function.name: memory_recall
function.description: Search explicitly stored long-term facts by topic label and/or free text. Use this only when a task may depend on information from earlier conversations that is not already present in the current conversation messages. This is not a conversation transcript, and an empty result does not mean no conversation occurred.

labels.description: Topic labels to recall (as shown in your memory topics). Omit to search across all topics.

query.description: Optional free-text filter; only memories whose content or keywords contain it are returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return.
